outputs.explanation: Panel A contains only micrograph images (GFP, DsRed, MitoTracker, Merge); no plot of averaged data is present.

Panel B includes bar charts (JC-1 relative intensity Green/Red, and anti-HMGB1 intensity) showing means with error bars (n=20 stated in caption) but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Panel C is a Western blot image; it contains no plot of averaged data.
Panel D includes bar charts of SDH and COX signal intensity showing group means with error bars and sample sizes indicated in the bars, but no individual data points are overlaid.
Panel E shows FACS histogram distributions (cell count vs. TMRM intensity), which are line/distribution plots, an exempt plot type that does not require overlaid individual data points.
